Reviewed the combined diff against the checklist; ran every gate of both repos on the branch head. Status words: D1, D2, D5 and D10 are owner decisions of 2026-10-05; D3 is not changed; every other D is a provisional default.

commit_split.how_to_read: One commit per decision group, in the order below. "pub" and "bank" list the files to stage whole in that group. A file that holds hunks of several groups is listed once, in the last of its groups in this order ("staged_whole_in"), and again under "shared_files" with the groups of its hunks: "hunks_by_group_new_line" gives the first line (in the working-tree file) of each -U0 hunk, classified by keyword, and "which_hunks" says it in words where this package checked it by hand. For a commit that holds only its own hunks, stage those with git add -p; staged whole, a shared file lands in its last group and the earlier commits may not build on their own. Only the final head was gated.
